theorems.name: Submission.allard52_c1_holder_of_ae_fderiv
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (c : Rn n) (r : ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0) (Z : Set (Rn n)) (M R α : ℝ), 0 ≤ M → 0 < R → 0 < α → LipschitzOnWith K f (ball c r) → Z ⊆ ball c r → volume (ball c r \ Z) = 0 → (∀ x ∈ Z, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) → (∀ x ∈ Z, ∀ y ∈ Z, hsNorm (fderiv ℝ f x - fderiv ℝ f y) ≤ M * (‖x - y‖ / R) ^ α) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f (ball c r) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball c r, ∀ y ∈ ball c r, hsNorm (fderiv ℝ f x - fderiv ℝ f y) ≤ M * (‖x - y‖ / R) ^ α
